mapper.sql: menu_id, menu_nm, menu_key, menu_type, url, sort_order, required_role, parent_menu_id, menu_dc, use_yn, public_yn, reg_id, mod_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM menu ORDER BY sort_order, menu_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM menu WHERE menu_key = #{menuKey} AND menu_id != #{menuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu (menu_nm, menu_key, menu_type, url, sort_order, required_role, parent_menu_id, menu_dc, use_yn, public_yn, reg_id, reg_dt, mod_id, mod_dt) VALUES (#{menuNm}, #{menuKey}, #{menuType}, #{url}, #{sortOrder}, #{requiredRole}, #{parentMenuId}, #{menuDc}, #{useYn}, #{publicYn}, #{regId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{modId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET menu_nm=#{menuNm}, menu_key=#{menuKey}, menu_type=#{menuType}, url=#{url}, sort_order=#{sortOrder}, required_role=#{requiredRole}, parent_menu_id=#{parentMenuId}, menu_dc=#{menuDc}, use_yn=#{useYn}, public_yn=#{publicYn}, mod_id=#{modId}, mod_dt=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE menu_id=#{menuId}
